summary: Good classic: the dynasties come fast, then the real puzzle is which teams have 3 wins versus 2. US-centric, so it fits best around Super Bowl time.
reasons: Casual found 9 and lost 4 on Eagles #11, Seahawks #14, Rams #12 and Ravens #17: recent champions with 2 wins, fair near misses. Washington is the stretch.
Data is current (Seahawks 2 after Super Bowl LX). Nicknames work well (pats, niners, redskins, chiefs), but 'bucs' is not recognized.
Blitz qualifies on paper but is just reciting the 32 teams, every one worth at least 10, so the classic suits it better. Hard for players outside the US.
fixes: Add alias 'Bucs' to Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
